# Castor — Full Technical Specification

> Machine-readable deep spec for LLMs, RAG pipelines, and AI search engines.
> Source of record:
> the 78-day `castor stats` ledger (Sep 4 – Nov 21, 2026), a
> `nvidia-smi` + vLLM 0.33.0 runtime snapshot (2026-11-21), the Qwen3.8-27B
> model card (Aug 14, 2026, Apache-2.0), and the `src/` codebase.

## 1. Product Overview

Castor (npm: `mcp-castor`, Rust crate, v1.6.0) is **zero-cloud-egress**
autonomous coding infrastructure. It runs AI coding agents in two wings:
**Wing 1 (Cloud + Local Hybrid)** pairs a **cloud lead architect**
(Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.2 Astra, Gemini 4 Argon) with a
**local peer model** (`Qwen3.8-27B` / `Ternary-Bonsai`) running on the user's
own GPU — the cloud model plans and reviews while the local model executes
the high-volume tool loop (file reads, edits, search, test runs) at
**$0.00 per token**; **Wing 2 (100% Local-Only & Air-Gapped)** runs agents
entirely on-prem with zero cloud API calls and zero code egress. All execution
stays inside a 5-layer sandbox and a loopback-only network boundary.

- License: **AGPL-3.0** (open source) **+ commercial dual-license**
  (opt-out) for air-gapped / enterprise deployments.
- Platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS.
- Repo: https://github.com/usecastor/castor
- Releases (native `win32-x64` zip alongside Linux `tar.gz`): https://github.com/usecastor/castor/releases
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mcp-castor
- Install: `npx -y mcp-castor install --client claude` (Claude Code),
  `--client antigravity` (Antigravity), or `--client all` (both).
  Cursor, Codex, and any other stdio MCP client connect via standard MCP
  config in their client settings.

Window: **2026-09-04 → 2026-11-21** (78 days), emitted by
`castor stats`.

| Metric | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Total tokens | 2,770,000,000 (2.77B) |
| Prompt tokens | 2,710,000,000 (2.71B) |
| Cached (session KV) tokens | 2,530,000,000 (2.53B) |
| Session KV-cache hit | **93.8%** (multi-turn history reused from VRAM, max_model_len 150,000) |
| Completion tokens | 62,150,000 (62.15M) |
| Reasoning tokens | 52,580,000 (52.58M, 84.6% of completion) |
| Autonomous turns | 49,414 |
| Sessions | 1,187 |
| Sandboxed tool calls | 67,506 (97.0% success) |
| Surgical edit ratio | 3.67× (surgical `edit_file` vs full `write_file` rewrites) |
| GPU compute time | 224.93 h (224h 56m) |
| Sustained decode (78d mean) | **70.4 tok/s** (single-stream n=1) |
| Concurrent aggregate decode | **260 tok/s** (n=4 concurrent streams, shared warm KV prefix) |
| Effective prefill | **3,247 tok/s** (warm + cold) |
| Avg TTFT | 14.15 s (78-day mean) |
| Cloud counterfactual (Sonnet-tier $2/$10) | $6,044.48 |
| Electricity cost | $10.12 (56.2 kWh @ $0.18/kWh) |
| **Net savings** | **$6,034.36 (99.83% of cloud cost)** |

## 3. Hardware & Engine Snapshot (2026-11-21)

- GPU: **NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090** — 23,869 / 24,576 MiB VRAM in use
  (~97% utilization), 244.6 W draw (262.5 W locked limit; 350 W stock TDP),
  56 °C, driver 616.92.
- Engine: **vLLM 0.33.0**, model `Qwen3.8-27B-W4A16-AutoRound-fast`,
  max model length 150,000 tokens.
- Single-day `/metrics` snapshot: 93.8% KV-cache hit, 70.5% MTP draft
  acceptance (mean acceptance length 3.45), 3.22 s average TTFT for that
  snapshot (78-day mean TTFT: 14.15 s).

## 4. VRAM Hardware Tier Matrix

| VRAM | Engine profile | Model class | Decode throughput |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 8–12 GB | llama.cpp / Ollama | 7B–14B coding models (W4A16 / Q4_K_M) | ~22–53 tok/s depending on model & quant |
| 16 GB | llama.cpp / Ollama | 14B–22B local models, or 27B with CPU offload (Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-PQ2_0) | ~38–53 tok/s |
| **24 GB+ (RTX 3090 / 4090 / A5000 Desktop / 5090)** | **vLLM 0.33.0 + Qwen3.8-27B-W4A16 + MTP** | **full 27B W4A16 in VRAM · 150K KV pool** | **70.4 tok/s sustained n=1 · 260 tok/s aggregate n=4 · 3,247 tok/s effective prefill** |

## 6. Qwen3.8-27B Vendor Benchmarks (Apache-2.0, model card 2026-08-14)

- SWE-bench Pro: 61.7
- LiveCodeBench v6: 90.3
- Terminal-Bench 2.1: 73.0
- OSWorld-Verified: 84.3

The W4A16-AutoRound-fast quantization served by Castor is ~¼ the weight
footprint of BF16 (~14 GB vs. ~54 GB BF16) on a 24 GB GPU.

## 7. Architecture (from `src/`)

- **MCP surface** (`src/mcp/mod.rs`): exactly **3 MCP tools** —
  `castor_coworker`, `castor_task`, `castor_server` — over stdio only;
  zero network listener. They dispatch a local worker running the
  **8-tool core**, `+ast` adds `ast_search` / `ast_replace` (**2 AST tools**),
  `+paper` adds `paper_lookup` (**1 paper tool**).
- **DGI Logit Gate** (`src/mcp/dgi.rs`): model-classified dispatch
  classifier, `delta_z = logP(OVERLOADED) − logP(ADMIT)`; rejects when
  `delta_z > 1.5`, routes near-ties (`|Δz| ≤ 1.5`) to Review.
- **Token-budgeted lease semaphore** (`src/task/semaphore/mod.rs`):
  cross-process task lease via atomic `O_EXCL` file create +
  ownership-checked unlink; a 90% soft ceiling on the committed-token
  pool halts new admission; KV-fill priority ranking lets the senior /
  heavier task finish first and free its cache.
- **Zero-turn wait** (`src/task/wait.rs`): loopback 127.0.0.1:18021
  long-poll (500 ms disk-mirror interval); zero-invalidation wakes cost
  no tokens.
- **SSE proxy** (`src/proxy/sanitize.rs`): loopback 127.0.0.1:18022
  OpenAI-compatible stream sanitizer with a repetition circuit breaker.
- **Ports**: engine :18020, status :18021, SSE proxy :18022 (all bound to
  loopback only).

## 8. Security — 5-Layer Zero-Trust Sandbox

Verified across **137 test vectors: 123 blocked / 14 allowed**
(`src/tools/sandbox/tests.rs:527`).

Path pipeline (`src/tools/sandbox/mod.rs`) — runs on every platform
(Linux, Windows, macOS):
- L1 `resolve_workspace_root` — canonical root anchor
- L2 `verify_symlink_containment` — realpath symlink-escape refusal
- L3 `refuse_out_of_tree` — strict boundary containment
- L4 `normalize_traversal` — null-byte / tilde / device-name / `..` collapse
- L5 `check_binary` — magic-number sniff → `BinaryFileError`

Companion runtime gates:
- **Lexical shell scanner + dead-man fuse** (`src/tools/shell/scanner.rs`):
  static lexical scan of the command line; destructive targets, protected
  roots, and a synthetic canary trip `FatalDeadManFuseError` before any
  execution — the command is not run and not retried.
- **Linux Landlock kernel confinement** (`src/tools/shell/process.rs`,
  Linux 5.13+ only): every shell child confined to the workspace root by a
  Landlock ruleset at exec; unsupported filesystems fall back to the
  lexical gates, never to an unconstrained process. On Windows and macOS
  the lexical scanner and path pipeline provide the confinement.
- **27-grammar Tree-Sitter AST syntax gate** (`src/tools/ast.rs`):
  **27** bundled grammars; `ast` is a compile-time Cargo feature included in
  the default build and the air-gapped `mcp,ast` profile — every file commit
  is parsed in memory before touching disk; malformed code is rejected and
  rolled back atomically. Once compiled in, the gate cannot be disabled at
  runtime.

**Compile-time offline binary profile** (air-gapped build):
`cargo build --release --no-default-features --features mcp,ast`
— there is no `web` Cargo feature; this profile excludes the `paper`
research feature and retains the core stdio MCP surface plus the AST gate.
MCP is stdio-only, and the engine, status, and SSE-proxy ports
(127.0.0.1:18020–18022) bind to loopback. For strict zero-egress
enforcement, pair this build with a host-OS default-deny outbound firewall
or air-gapped enclave networking and disable external web tool config.
Verify with `ss -ltnp` / `nmap` (Linux) or `netstat -ano` (Windows).

## 9. Deployment & Commercial — Two Wings, Four Fronts

**The Two Wings** (the two ways to run agents):
- **Wing 1 · Cloud + Local Hybrid** — keep Claude Code, Antigravity, Cursor,
  or Codex as your frontier architect (it still talks to its own cloud
  provider for planning/review) while the high-volume file reads, code
  searches, AST edits, and test runs route to your local GPU at $0 per token.
- **Wing 2 · 100% Local-Only & Air-Gapped** — run coding agents entirely on
  your own GPU workstations or on-prem servers: zero cloud API calls, zero
  code egress, fully self-contained for regulated and offline environments.

**The Four Fronts** (turnkey engineering teams):
- **Open-Source Engine** — Castor Core, **$0**, AGPL-3.0 open source.
- **$1,500 48-Hour GPU & vLLM Setup Sprint** — turnkey dedicated-hardware
  stand-up (vLLM/CUDA/quantization tuning, sandbox hardening, IDE onboarding,
  benchmark + egress-audit handoff).
- **Custom Agent Workflow Plumbing** — agent orchestration, sandbox &
  shell-policy hardening, and team IDE rollout wired into the tool loop your
  agents already run.
- **Air-Gapped On-Prem Pilot** — fixed-scope 10–50 seat pilot over a fixed
  1–3 month scope, commercial dual-license; air-gapped on-prem deployment and
  per-task JSONL audit logs designed to support NIST 800-171, CMMC Level 2,
  and ITAR enclaves.
